lines.text: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the pyramids.
Let's squeeze history into one day. The Great Pyramid was finished around twenty-five sixty BC. Call that midnight.
lines.caption: Let's squeeze history into one day. The Great Pyramid was finished around 2560 BC. Call that midnight.

lines.text: Cleopatra is born about two and a half thousand years later. That's already past lunchtime.
lines.caption: Cleopatra is born about 2,500 years later. That's already past lunchtime.

lines.text: From her to Apollo eleven? Only about two thousand years. Midnight again.
lines.caption: From her to Apollo 11? Only about 2,000 years. Midnight again.

lines.text: To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient history.
